plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-opencode-free **Free OpenCode Zen models, natively inside DSH (DeepSeek Harness).** No API key. No registration. No extra process. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@dsh-opencode-free%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@dsh-opencode-free/dsh-plugin) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@dsh-opencode-free%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://github.com/ddldxiacan/dsh-opencode-free/blob/master/LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-blue)](https://github.com/ddldxiacan/dsh-opencode-free) English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
--- dsh-opencode-free registers a native DSH `LlmAdapter` that streams directly from [OpenCode Zen](https://opencode.ai/zen)'s **anonymous free lane** — the same models OpenCode's own CLI uses without an account, served to your DSH model picker as a regular provider called `dsh-opencode-free`. Requests leave your machine looking exactly like traffic from the OpenCode CLI (same user agent, same correlation headers), and the model catalog stays fresh through a three-tier fallback chain. There is nothing to log into and nothing to host. > **Upgrading from `opencode2dsh`?** This project was renamed. The plugin now > installs as `@dsh-opencode-free/dsh-plugin` with the provider, settings entry > and data directory all under the new name. Your saved IP-pool settings and the > old `~/.opencode2dsh` cache are copied once on first start — see > [Renamed from opencode2dsh](#renamed-from-opencode2dsh). ## Highlights - **Zero credential, zero setup** — the anonymous lane needs no key; install, restart, chat - **Native adapter, no sidecar** — one npm package, no child process, no binary, no local port (the legacy Go sidecar is not part of the published package; see `legacy/`) - **CLI-identical disguise** — requests carry the OpenCode CLI user agent and its session/request/project header set, derived per conversation - **Selectable thinking levels** — reasoning-capable free models expose an effort picker in DSH's model selector (declared ladders where the model metadata provides them, Off/Minimal/Low/Medium/High otherwise); Responses-only `muse-spark-*` models expose only upstream-supported effort levels, and no selection keeps the provider default - **Image input where it is declared** — image attachments are accepted for every model whose [models.dev](https://models.dev) entry lists `image` in `modalities.input`, and refused for the ones that declare `text` only; models.dev being silent falls back to the live-verified vision family - **Live catalog with a fallback chain** — live upstream list ∩ free-by-metadata, falling back to offline cache and a verified static list - **Self-healing** — fast startup retries, periodic refresh, and a written health snapshot for diagnostics - **Proper error surfaces** — upstream failures (rate limit, auth, timeout, transport) arrive in DSH as classified finish reasons, and retries stay owned by DSH ## Install Installs from a prebuilt release, so no build step and no toolchain is needed. **Read the three steps in order** — doing the install before step 2 fails silently, in a way that looks like success (see below). **1. Make sure the profile exists.** Any `dsh plugin` command initializes it: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web list ``` **2. Approve two build scripts *before* the first install.** They are `@google/genai` and `protobufjs`, pulled in transitively by `@earendil-works/pi-ai`; pnpm blocks dependency build scripts by default. Append this to the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` (`~/.dsh/profiles/web/pnpm-workspace.yaml`, under `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\web\` on Windows): ```yaml allowBuilds: '@google/genai': false protobufjs: false ``` `false` keeps the scripts disabled — it records the decision pnpm is waiting for, which is all that is needed. (Upstream ships the same two as `false`.) **3. Install:** ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/ddldxiacan/dsh-opencode-free/releases/latest/download/dsh-opencode-free-dsh-plugin.tgz ``` The version-free link is a stable bookmark for the *first* install. It is deliberately **not** the update command: pnpm records the URL it resolved in `pnpm-lock.yaml` together with the tarball's integrity hash, and a URL that never changes is treated as already resolved ("Lockfile is up to date, resolution step is skipped") — re-adding it keeps the version you have. Use the tag-scoped asset for updates (see [Updating](#updating)). ### Why step 2 comes first Skip it and the first install stops at `ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS` — but pnpm has already written the dependency into the profile's `package.json`. DSH registers a newly installed package as a profile *bundle* only when that pnpm run exits 0 **and** the package is a new dependency. So the retry is no longer "new", the registration is skipped, and the run exits **0** with the plugin present on disk in `node_modules` but never added to `dsh.profile.bundles` — meaning it never loads and no models appear. Nothing in the output says so. If you have already hit that, recover with a remove and re-add: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web remove @dsh-opencode-free/dsh-plugin dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/ddldxiacan/dsh-opencode-free/releases/latest/download/dsh-opencode-free-dsh-plugin.tgz ``` To confirm the plugin is really registered, check that the profile's `package.json` lists `@dsh-opencode-free/dsh-plugin` under `dsh.profile.bundles` — not just under `dependencies`. ### Other ways to install **In the Web UI**: **Settings → Plugins → Install**, and paste the same tarball URL. The Web page writes the same kind of approval and has its own bundle selection; the CLI steps above are the path verified here. **From GitHub directly** (no registry involved): ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:ddldxiacan/dsh-opencode-free ``` This works because the repository root *is* the installable plugin: it carries the `dsh` manifest, and the built output is committed under `packages/plugin/lib/`. A git install cannot run a build — pnpm blocks prepare scripts for git dependencies — so shipping the build is what makes this path work. Pinning a tag is recommended for stability: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:ddldxiacan/dsh-opencode-free#v0.4.0 ``` **From npm** (once the package is published): ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @dsh-opencode-free/dsh-plugin ``` **Verify**: restart `dsh web`, open the model picker, and pick a model from the **dsh-opencode-free** group. ### Updating Pick the source you installed from; each updates in place. **Release tarball.** Use the tag-scoped asset, not the version-free one: ```sh # replace 0.4.2 with the release you are moving to dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/ddldxiacan/dsh-opencode-free/releases/download/v0.4.2/dsh-opencode-free-dsh-plugin-0.4.2.tgz ``` The version-free `releases/latest/download/...` URL does **not** update an existing install: pnpm resolved it once and pinned the URL plus its integrity hash in `pnpm-lock.yaml`, so re-adding it is a no-op ("Lockfile is up to date, resolution step is skipped") — even with `--force`, `pnpm update`, `pnpm install --force`, or a deleted `node_modules`. Only a URL that differs per release re-resolves. If you are stuck on an older build that predates the versioned asset, do the one-time move with an explicit remove + add (or the versioned URL, which works even then): ```sh dsh plugin --profile web remove @dsh-opencode-free/dsh-plugin dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/ddldxiacan/dsh-opencode-free/releases/latest/download/dsh-opencode-free-dsh-plugin.tgz ``` **git install**: follow master (a git spec re-resolves each time): ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:ddldxiacan/dsh-opencode-free ``` **npm install**: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @dsh-opencode-free/dsh-plugin@latest ``` Then restart DSH. To confirm the new version landed, compare the profile's `node_modules//package.json` with the release you expected, and check the health snapshot at `~/.dsh-opencod

plugins.description: A DSH statusline that keeps the shipped statistics pills and splits model time into first-token wait and decode.
plugins.readme_text:
# @gitsang/dsh-statusline

A DSH statusline that keeps the shipped composer statistics **exactly as they
look** and adds the one thing the stock dialog cannot show: a split of model
time into first-token time and output time.

The composer keeps the original two pills:

```
21 turns 279 steps · 59 tok/s      53.6M tok · Cache hit 99%
```

Clicking the gauge pill opens the same anchored dialog style as before, with
three extra rows:

```
Session statistics
  LLM time               7h18m
  First-token time       6h13m
  Output time            1h00m
  Tool time              28m59s
  Avg time to first token (TTFT)   1m23s
  Tokens per second (TPS)          60 tok/s
```

The token-usage pill keeps its original dialog and wording unchanged.

## Why?

`sessionStats` already records enough to split the **observed** model time:

| Field | Span |
|---|---|
| `llmMs` | `step/start` → `assistant/message` |
| `ttftMs` | `step/start` → first non-empty streamed delta |
| `decodeMs` | first delta → `assistant/message`, on steps that report output tokens (shown as **output time**) |

The dialog shows the total, the first-token span, the output span, tool time,
the average first-token latency, and throughput.

`ttftMs` is a **client-observed wall time**. It includes request dispatch,
networking, server queueing, prefill, and generation of the first token. A
provider that reports true prefill time would need its adapter to record it;
the UI does not relabel a client clock as "prefill" before that exists.

## Visual parity

This package replaces the shipped `stats` cell of `conversation.composer.dock`
(registering the same id at `priority: -1`). It deliberately reuses:

- the shipped `IconGaugeOutlineRegular` and `IconDatabaseOutlineRegular` icons;
- the shipped `useAnchoredPosition` and `useDismissOnOutsidePointer` primitives;
- field-for-field CSS values from `StatsPills.module.css` and
  `stat-dialog.module.css` (pill padding/gap/radius/colors, 12px/20px strip
  type, 300–440px panel, 16px panel padding, elevation, hover and focus states);
- the same `data-composer-stats` hook, so `dsh-mobile`'s existing compact rules
  continue to apply.

Pill boxes and computed styles were compared in a real page against the stock
component: desktop and 390px mobile produce the same 22px row, the same pill
sizes, and the same colors. The only intended visual difference is the taller
time dialog caused by the three added rows.

## Data sources

No Host half, log replay, or provider request is added. The browser half reads
existing Host-computed projections:

| Projection | Used for |
|---|---|
| `sessionStats` | turns, steps, model time, first-token time, output time/tokens, tool time |
| `tokenUsage` | cumulative uncached/cache/output token buckets |

The projections fold the complete durable log, so paging and compaction do not
change the figures. Missing projections hide the affected pill.

## Install

From GitHub:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:gitsang/dsh-statusline
```

Or from a local checkout:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-statusline
```

Then enable the bundle in `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json` (or on the Plugins
page):

```json
{
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": [
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-base",
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app",
        "@gitsang/dsh-statusline"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

Restart `dsh web` and hard-reload the browser.

## Development

The browser half is plain JavaScript with no build step. It registers through
`window.__ModuleLoader__` and takes React, React DOM, and UI primitives from the
client module table.

```bash
node --check src/client.js
node --test
```

The tests load the real browser half through a fake module-loader registration
and cover the pure folds: time splitting, the unattributed remainder, token
buckets, the shipped cache-hit formatting, and the slot registration.

## Compatibility

- Web profile only; no TUI rendering.
- Timing requires `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-stats` (`sessionStats`); token
  accounting requires `@deepseek-ai/dsh-token-meter` (`tokenUsage`). Both ship
  with the Web profile.
- The replacement couples to the shipped slot id `stats` in
  `conversation.composer.dock`. If a future release renames it, this package
  becomes an additional pill instead of a replacement; the dialogs still work.
- The shipped **compact / detailed** performance preference is not read by this
  replacement, so the two detailed pills are always rendered when data exists.
- All visible copy is registered in the `statusline` locale namespace
  (`zh` and `en`).

## License

MIT

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-locale-russian

Русская локализация web-интерфейса [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

[![checks](https://github.com/nemezida1337/dsh-locale-russian/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/nemezida1337/dsh-locale-russian/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

Индекс маркета: `https://nemezida1337.github.io/dsh-locale-russian/index.json` — добавьте его на странице **Плагины → Обзор**, чтобы установить пакет оттуда.

Пакет — обычный клиентский плагин DSH: он добавляет язык `ru` в расширяемый каталог локалей и регистрирует переводы для всех namespace интерфейса. Недостающие ключи автоматически показываются по-английски, поэтому неполный перевод не ломает интерфейс. Одновременно это bundle, поэтому ставится одной командой и умеет обновляться как обычный пакет.

- **Охват:** 3058 строк в 65 namespace — все строки интерфейса, которые показывает приложение: панели, настройки, диалоги, карточки инструментов, подсказки, тексты ошибок UI, единицы измерения и форматы дат. Строки сняты и с CLI-сборки, и с установленного приложения (`app.asar`); пропущенных ключей нет (см. `reports/coverage.json`).
- **Терминология:** единый глоссарий ([GLOSSARY.md](GLOSSARY.md)) и правила стиля ([STYLE.md](STYLE.md)).
- **Склонения:** русские формы множественного числа выбираются по `Intl.PluralRules('ru')`, а не по английскому правилу «1 или много».
- **Описания плагинов:** подписи карточек в разделе «Встроенные плагины» тоже переводятся — 421 строка из манифестов и `locale/*.json` пакетов, таблица `dictionary/plugin-meta.json`, подстановка через `LocaleRuntime.resolveText`.

## Установка

Пакет не требует форка DeepSeek Harness и не меняет его файлы.

### Обычная установка

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-locale-russian
```

Команда ставит пакет из npm в указанный профиль через pnpm, добавляет его в `dependencies` и в `dsh.profile.bundles`, после чего строка `locale-ru` появляется в собранном дереве. Так же устанавливается из git, tarball или локального пути:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:nemezida1337/dsh-locale-russian
dsh plugin --profile web add file:/абсолютный/путь/к/рабочей/копии
```

### Приложение DeepSeek Harness (desktop)

Профиль `desktop` принадлежит Electron-приложению, и CLI отказывается им управлять. Поэтому пакет подключают либо строкой патча на локальную копию, либо установкой в профиль вручную.

**Строка патча** — удобно, когда нужна живая рабочая копия:

1. Возьмите копию репозитория в постоянное место, например `~/Developer/dsh-locale-russian`.
2. Добавьте строку в `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`, сохранив остальные записи:

   ```yaml
   - insert:
       - id: locale-ru
         name: file:///абсолютный/путь/к/dsh-locale-russian/lib/index.js
   ```

3. Перезапустите приложение.

**Обычная установка из npm** — то же, что делает `dsh plugin`, но вручную: добавьте `"dsh-locale-russian": "^0.1.2"` в `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json` и в его `dsh.profile.bundles`, затем выполните `pnpm add dsh-locale-russian` в каталоге профиля (pnpm лежит внутри приложения: `…/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/primary-runtime/dependencies/pnpm/bin/pnpm.mjs`).

В обоих случаях дальше откройте **Настройки → Общие → Язык** и выберите **Русский**; выбор сохраняется в `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`. Если система и браузер приложения настроены на русский, интерфейс переключится сам при первом запуске после установки.

### Удаление

Удалите добавленную строку из `cordis.patch.yml` (и запись зависимости из `package.json` профиля при установке через `dsh plugin`) и перезапустите приложение. Настройка языка очистится сама при следующем изменении языка.

## Как это работает

1. Плагин объявляет язык: `ctx.locale.addLanguage({ id: 'ru', label: 'Русский', fallback: 'en' })`.
2. Для каждого namespace регистрируется словарь: `ctx.locale.register(namespace, 'ru', {...})`. Ключи совпадают с оригинальными, значения — русские.
3. Русские склонения: словарь может хранить до трёх форм, разделённых `|`, а пакет подменяет `LocaleRuntime.prototype.translate`, выбирая форму по числу из параметров вызова. Для не-`ru` локалей вызывается исходный метод без изменений, поэтому английский и китайский интерфейсы работают ровно как раньше.

4. Метаданные плагинов: описания и названия пакетов приходят от хоста как `LocalizedText` и рисуются через `LocaleRuntime.resolveText`. Пакет подменяет и этот метод, подставляя русский текст из таблицы `dictionary/plugin-meta.json`; если пакет отдаёт свой русский вариант, он выигрывает.

Подробнее о формате форм — в [STYLE.md](STYLE.md#множественные-числа).

## Разработка

```sh
node tools/extract-static.mjs     # словари из установленной сборки DSH
node tools/extract-repo.mjs       # словари из исходников репозитория
node tools/build-inventory.mjs    # объединённый инвентарь строк
node tools/build-batches.mjs      # батчи для перевода
node tools/lint-translations.mjs  # проверка переводов (глоссарий, плейсхолдеры, склонения)
node tools/build-package.mjs      # сборка dictionary/ru.json и lib/
node tools/verify-package.mjs     # проверка собранного бандла без браузера
node tools/report-drift.mjs       # ключи, у которых английский текст изменился между сборками
node tools/apply-reviews.mjs      # перенос правок рецензентов в dictionary/overrides.json
node tools/extract-asar.mjs       # клиентские пакеты из app.asar установленного приложения
node tools/extract-plugin-meta.mjs # описания пакетов-плагинов для раздела «Встроенные плагины»
node tools/build-plugin-batches.mjs # батчи этих описаний
node tools/build-market.mjs       # индекс маркета плагинов (market/index.json)
node tools/validate-market.mjs    # проверка индекса официальным валидатором DSH
node tools/mark-translated.mjs    # запомнить английский текст, по которому сделан перевод
node tools/refresh.mjs            # вся цепочка обновления одной командой
node tools/gui-sweep.mjs          # обход интерфейса: текст, скриншоты, обрезки
node tools/screenshot-gui.mjs     # снимок одного экрана (для отладки)
```

Если вы делаете свой плагин для DSH — практическое руководство со всеми граблями лежит в [contrib/plugin-recipe.md](contrib/plugin-recipe.md).

Общие помощники лежат в `tools/lib`: `cdp.mjs` — запуск headless Chrome и операции над страницей, `parse-js.mjs` — чтение словарей из бандлов и исходников, `paths.mjs` — сокращение машинных путей в отчётах.

Порядок извлечения строк:

```sh
node tools/extract-asar.mjs --out .app-packages                       # пакеты приложения из app.asar
DSH_CLIENT_PKG_ROOT="$PWD/.app-packages" node tools/extract-static.mjs --out strings/app.json
node tools/extract-static.mjs                                        # пакеты CLI-сборки
node tools/extract-repo.mjs                                          # исходники репозитория
node tools/build-inventory.mjs                                       # объединить: приложение → CLI → репозиторий
node tools/build-batches.mjs --delta                                 # только новое и изменившееся
```

Готовые переводы лежат в `translations/*.json` по батчам; `dictionary/ru.json` — результат сборки. Отчёты проверок — в `reports/`.

Строки берутся из трёх источников по убыванию приоритета: клиентские пакеты **установленного приложения** (распакованные из `app.asar`), пакеты CLI-сборки и исходники репозитория. Приоритетный источник задаёт английский текст, который видит переводчик; батч `p3` (дельта приложения) перекрывает ранее переведённые ключи, у которых текст изменился.

### После выхода новой версии DSH

1. Обновите приложение и склонируйте свежий репозиторий (`git pull`).
2. Запустите `npm run refresh` — одна команда проходит всю цепочку: распаковывает `app.asar`, снимает словари приложения, CLI-сборки и репозитория, пересобирает метаданные плагинов, инвентарь, батчи дельты и отчёт о расхождениях. В конце печатается сводка: сколько строк без перевода, сколько переписано, сколько описаний плагинов не хватает.
3. Переведите файлы `batches/p3-*.json` (строки интерфейса) и `batches/plugin-*.json` (описания плагинов).
4. Отметьте раунд как завершённый: `npm run mark-translated` — команда запоминает, по какому английскому тексту сделан перевод, чтобы д

plugins.description: 分流对话 · Plugins of Conversation Departure — DSH 侧边栏项目上下文打包插件（纯本地，不联网）
plugins.readme_text:
# 分流对话 · dsh-dual-bridge

**Plugins of Conversation Departure** — 把「读项目」分流给免费的 DeepSeek 网页版，把「改代码」留给 Harness API。

> DeepSeek Harness（DSH）侧边栏插件：把项目上下文**打包成结构化 prompt** → 复制到剪贴板 → **同屏打开** DeepSeek 网页版粘贴提问。
>
> 定位是「双入口分流」：**读项目/答疑走网页版（免费），复杂推理/改码仍走 Harness API（计费）**。
>
> 纯本地：不联网、不爬虫、不操控浏览器、不调用网页版任何接口，也不上传任何文件。

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-dual-bridge.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-dual-bridge)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-dual-bridge.svg)](LICENSE)
[![CI](https://github.com/xiez0324-rgb/dsh-dual-bridge/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/xiez0324-rgb/dsh-dual-bridge/actions)

## 安装

> ⚠️ **必须先装 `dsh-better-sidebar`。** 本插件的 UI 挂在它的侧边栏上；而 DSH 的 bundle 挂载只认
> **profile 的直接依赖**（传递依赖会被装进 `node_modules`，但**不会**被挂载），所以只装本插件会出现
> 「装好了但界面没变化」的静默失败。

**一条命令装好（推荐）**

```bash
dsh plugin add dsh-better-sidebar && dsh plugin add dsh-dual-bridge
```

**从插件市场装**：在市场（Discover）里先搜 `dsh-better-sidebar` 装上，再搜 `dsh-dual-bridge`。

**从本仓库直装（不走 npm）**

```bash
dsh plugin add dsh-better-sidebar && \
dsh plugin add git+https://github.com/xiez0324-rgb/dsh-dual-bridge.git
```

装完**重启一次 `dsh web`**（host 端路由要加载），刷新页面后侧边栏出现「⇄ 分流对话」Tab。

> 只装本插件忘了装前置时，host 日志会打印明确提示：
> `[dsh-dual-bridge] 未检测到 dsh-better-sidebar 服务 …`

**版本要求**：`engines.dsh` 为 `>=0.2.1-rc.1 <0.3.0`（`dsh --version` 可查）。

## 30 秒上手

1. 在 DSH 里打开一个会话（需要有工作区），侧边栏点「⇄ 分流对话」
2. 展开目录，勾选要问的文件（勾目录 = 整棵子树；默认什么都不选）
3. 点「📦 打包选中文件」→「📋 复制到剪贴板」
4. 点「🚀 同屏打开网页版」→ 在网页版输入框 `Cmd/Ctrl+V` 粘贴 → 提问
5. 需要改代码/复杂推理时，回 Harness 走 API

> PDF/Word/PPT/Excel/RTF 先点「提取文字」，图片点「OCR 文字」——提取结果也会进剪贴板。
> 无法转文本的文件（视频/压缩包等）会自动打包到 `~/Desktop/dsh-pack-<时间戳>/`，拖进网页版上传即可。

---

## 它解决什么问题

在 Harness 里读代码、解释项目、回答"这个功能怎么实现的"，每次都要消耗 API token。
这类**上下文密集型**任务其实是免费的网页版最擅长的。本插件负责把"上下文搬运"这半件事做到顺手：

```
① 扫描工作区 → 目录树勾选 → 设 token 预算 → 打包并复制
② 一键同屏打开 DeepSeek 网页版（右侧并排窗口，不占用当前标签页）
③ Cmd/Ctrl + V 粘贴 → 提问（免费）
④ 需要改代码/复杂推理 → 回到 Harness 走 API
```

## 功能

| 能力 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 项目扫描 | 解析 `.gitignore` + 内置 30+ 排除规则（`node_modules`、`.git`、`build`、`__pycache__`、`.env` …）；扫描上限可调（500 / 2000 / 10000 / 不限，默认 2000）并**显式报告截断** |
| 目录树选择 | 可折叠；勾选目录 = 选中整棵子树（三态含半选）；默认不选任何文件；「全选 / 仅代码 / 全不选」 |
| 二进制可见 | PDF/Office/图片不出现"凭空消失"：目录标注「不可打包 N」，文件行置灰 |
| token 预算 | 按 1 token ≈ 4 字符估算；「超预算时」可选**只提示 / 按预算截断**（贪心填充，被丢文件逐条列出） |
| prompt 组装 | 项目结构树 + 逐文件代码块（语言标注、反引号自适应） |
| 附件声明（可选） | 勾选后把**同目录**下未包含的附件列进 prompt（上限 20 条），默认关闭 |
| 按需文本抽取 | 对单个 PDF/Office 文件点「抽取文本」，抽出的正文并入 prompt（见下方平台支持） |
| 同屏打开网页版 | 贴在屏幕右侧的独立窗口 + 自动聚焦；重复点击只聚焦、不刷新已有对话 |
| 复制到剪贴板 | 一步写入系统剪贴板 |

## 架构

```
┌──────────────────────────────┐        ┌──────────────────────────────────┐
│ 浏览器：侧边栏 UI            │        │ DSH 的 Node 进程（host）          │
│ lib/client.js                │ fetch  │ lib/index.js                     │
│ · 目录树 / 勾选 / token 预算 │ ─────▶ │ 本地路由（仅 127.0.0.1 可达）     │
│ · 组装 prompt / 剪贴板       │        │  /dual-bridge/capabilities       │
│ · 同屏窗口（window.open）    │        │  /dual-bridge/extract            │
│                              │        │  /dual-bridge/ocr                │
│ 读不到二进制原文、不能起进程 │        │  /dual-bridge/bundle             │
└──────────────────────────────┘        │  /dual-bridge/reveal             │
                                        └──────────────────────────────────┘
```

| 设计点 | 原因 |
|---|---|
| **UI / host 分离** | 浏览器侧读不到二进制原文（`fs.read` 只回文本），也不能启动子进程；解析与写文件必须落到 host |
| **能力探测** | UI 先问 `/capabilities`（PDF/Office/OCR 是否可用），**只显示真正能用的按钮**，杜绝"点了才报不支持" |
| **纯函数内核** | 目录树、预算裁剪、OOXML/RTF 解析、OCR 引擎链都是无副作用函数，可单测（**83 个测试**） |
| **路径围栏** | host 端所有文件操作都校验"必须在本会话工作区内"；子进程一律 `argv` 数组，不拼 shell |
| **显式截断** | 扫描上限、读取上限、预算截断、超大文件全部**明说**，不静默少文件 |
| **失败降级** | 缺 poppler 就不显示 PDF 按钮；host 版本落后会提示重启，而不是行为错位 |
| **跨平台** | docx/pptx/xlsx/rtf 用内置 ZIP+XML 解析（不依赖 macOS `textutil`）；OCR 三级链 Vision → tesseract → 内置 WASM；`reveal`/`zip` 按平台分支 |

## 平台支持

| 能力 | macOS | Linux | Windows |
|---|---|---|---|
| 扫描 / 打包 / 复制 / 同屏打开 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| **docx / pptx / xlsx / rtf 抽取** | ✅ 内置解析器 | ✅ 内置解析器 | ✅ 内置解析器 |
| 旧版二进制 `.doc` | ✅ textutil | ❌ 建议另存为 docx | ❌ 建议另存为 docx |
| PDF 抽取 | ✅ 需 poppler | ✅ 需 poppler | ✅ 需 poppler |
| **图片 OCR** | ✅ Vision（最快）→ 内置 WASM | ✅ 内置 WASM | ✅ 内置 WASM |
| 导出包打 zip | ✅ `zip` | ✅ `zip` | ✅ `Compress-Archive` |
| 在文件管理器中显示 | ✅ `open -R` | ✅ `xdg-open` | ✅ `explorer /select,` |

**OCR 开箱可用**：内置 `tesseract.js`(WASM) + 中文训练数据，Windows/Linux/macOS 都**无需安装**。
macOS 若可用会优先走系统 Vision（更快更准），否则自动退回 WASM。
代价：相关依赖安装后约 **+80MB**（`tesseract.js-core` 49MB + `chi_sim` 22MB + `eng` 14MB）。

**poppler 不在 npm 包里**（它约 200MB，仅 PDF 抽取需要）。装完即可，插件会自动发现，**不需要配环境变量**：

```bash
brew install poppler                                      # macOS
sudo apt install -y poppler-utils                         # Debian/Ubuntu
# Windows：解压 poppler-windows 到 %LOCALAPPDATA%\poppler
```

自动探测顺序：`DSH_DUAL_BRIDGE_POPPLER` → `PATH` → Homebrew（`/opt/homebrew/bin`、`/opt/homebrew/opt/poppler/bin`）→ `/usr/local/bin` → conda 常见目录 → Windows `%LOCALAPPDATA%\poppler`。

没有 poppler 时：PDF 按钮不显示，DOCX/PPTX/XLSX/RTF 与 OCR 不受影响。**扫描件/图片型 PDF 抽不出文字**——这类请直接把文件拖进网页版上传。

## 安装

### 前置

- DSH ≥ 0.2.1-rc.2
- `dsh-better-sidebar@0.28.0`：本插件的 Tab 由它提供宿主，必须一起安装（同一条命令里写两个包）。

### 一条命令（桌面 App / CLI）

```bash
# 桌面 App（profile = desktop）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-dual-bridge dsh-better-sidebar@0.28.0 --allow-build=tesseract.js

# 命令行版 dsh web（profile = web）
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-dual-bridge dsh-better-sidebar@0.28.0 --allow-build=tesseract.js
```

说明：

- **两个包要写进同一条命令**：DSH 只把 profile 的直接依赖登记为 bundle。先装 sidebar 再装插件也能用，但分成两条命令时第二步如果被 pnpm 的构建拦截打断，bundle 就不会登记。
- 为什么不把 sidebar 塞进本包的 patch 自动挂载：实测会重复注册 `/sidebar/api`（已有 sidebar 的 profile）或拿不到 `betterSidebar` 服务（没有 sidebar 的 profile）。DSH 的 bundle 层不支持“包内再挂一个 bundle”，所以 sidebar 必须是 profile 的直接依赖。
- `--allow-build=tesseract.js` 只放行 OCR 引擎的一条 postinstall（opencollective 提示），不影响其它包。
- 装完**完全退出并重开 App**（host 端路由只在启动时加载）。

### 在 App 内安装

Plugins 页依次安装 `dsh-better-sidebar@0.28.0` 和 `dsh-dual-bridge`，两个都 **Enable now**，构建脚本提示选「允许」，然后重启 App。

### 从 0.13.0 升级

0.13.0 尝试过自动挂载 sidebar，已在 0.13.1 撤回。升级时用上面的双包命令覆盖安装即可；若 profile 里留下了 `dual-bridge-sidebar` 条目，先删掉那一行再重启。

### 本地开发安装

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop
pnpm add link:/path/to/dsh-dual-bridge
```

## 使用

1. 打开侧边栏 **「⇄ 分流对话」**
2. 等扫描完成（顶部显示 `N 个可打包文件 · M 个目录`）
3. 展开目录、勾选要带的文件（勾目录 = 整棵子树）
4. 设 token 预算、选「超预算时」的策略
5. 点 **📦 打包选中文件** → 看预览 → **📋 复制到剪贴板**
6. 点 **🚀 同屏打开网页版** → 在网页版输入框 Cmd/Ctrl+V 粘贴 → 提问

### 关于 PDF / Office

- 二进制文件**不会**被当成代码打包；它们在树里置灰显示，可点「抽取文本」
- 抽取是**按需、逐个**的：不会因为选了七个 PDF 就把预算打爆
- 抽取结果带「已抽取 N 字 / 移除」，进入 prompt 的【抽取的附件文本】段
- 排版损失不可避免（双栏会串行、公式可能变乱码）。**保真度要求高就直接上传原文件**

### 为什么不能把网页版内嵌在页面里？

DeepSeek 网页版响应头声明：

```
content-security-policy: frame-ancestors 'none'
```

`'none'` 表示**任何站点都不允许 iframe 内嵌它**（Harness 自带的「内嵌浏览器」也会显示"拒绝了嵌入请求"）。
这是站点安全策略、由浏览器强制执行，前端无法绕过；唯一能绕过的办法是本地代理改响应头或浏览器扩展去 CSP —— 那既越界也不合理。

所以本插件用**同屏独立窗口**（贴在侧边栏右侧、自动聚焦）达到"并排、不用切标签"的效果。

## 隐私与合规

- **不联网**：扫描、打包、复制、抽取全部在本机完成；插件没有任何出站请求
- **不上传**：文件内容只进你的剪贴板，由你自己决定粘贴到哪里
- **不自动化**：不操控浏览器、不模拟点击、不调用网页版接口
- **抽取路由只在 localhost**：`POST /dual-bridge/extract` 挂在 DSH 已有的本地 web 服务上（不额外开端口），并限制只能抽取**当前会话工作区之内**的文件；`execFile` + argv 数组（路径不作为 shell 片段）
- 唯一的网络行为是「打开一个新的浏览器窗口指向 chat.deepseek.com」——由你的浏览器自己发起

## 已知限制

1. **依赖 `dsh-better-sidebar` 的内部路由**（`POST /sidebar/api/{session.cwd, fs.tree, fs.trees, fs.read}`）。
   这些接口不是公开 API，上游改字段本插件就会失效——已在 `dependencies` 中锁定版本。
2. **host 端改动需重启 `dsh web`**；client 改动刷新页面即可。
3. 子目录里嵌套的 `.gitignore` 不解析（只读项目根）。
4. 不跟随目录软链。
5. 扫描上限默认 2000 个文件（可在界面调整）；超大仓库建议把扫描范围收窄到子目录。
6. 抽取为纯文本，**丢失排版/表格/图片/公式结构**。
7. OCR 质量：macOS Vision > 系统 tesseract > 内置 WASM。WASM 对**排版规范的文档截图**较准，
   对**艺术字/宣传海报**容易出噪声——这类图建议直接上传原图让 AI 看图。
8. 首次 OCR 需初始化 WASM worker（约 0.3–1s），之后复用。

## 开发

```bash
npm install
npm run typecheck     # tsc --noEmit (strict)
npm run test          # node --test（59 个用例）
npm run build         # esbuild -> lib/index.js + lib/client.js
npm run verify        # 三条一起跑
npm run pack:check    # 检查 npm 包内容（确认不含 vendor/）
```

工程结构：

```
src/
  client.tsx        # client 入口：注册「分流对话」Tab
  DualBridgeTab.tsx # Tab UI：扫描/树/预算/打包/复制/抽取/同屏打开
  file-tree.ts      # 目录树纯逻辑（三态勾选、跳过统计）
  pack.ts           # 过滤规则、prompt 组装、预算裁剪、附件筛选
  split-window.ts   # 同屏窗口几何（纯函数 + 打开逻辑）
  api.ts            # 复刻 bet

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 0.2.1+ compatibility build of @memtensor/memos-local-plugin — installable via dsh plugin add
plugins.readme_text:
# @memtensor/memos-local-plugin

> Reflect2Evolve memory plugin for AI agents.
> One algorithm core, with adapters for OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and DeepSeek
> Harness.

## What it is

A local-first, file-backed memory system that gives an agent four cooperating
layers of memory and a feedback-driven self-evolution loop:

- **L1 trace** — step-level grounded records (action + observation + reflection + value).
- **L2 policy** — sub-task strategies induced across many traces.
- **L3 world model** — compressed environmental cognition derived from L2 + L1.
- **Skill** — callable, crystallized capabilities the agent can invoke directly.

The plugin learns continuously from two feedback channels:

- **Step-level** — model ↔ environment (tool result, observation deltas).
- **Task-level** — human ↔ model (explicit ratings + implicit signals).

Reflection-weighted reward is back-propagated along each trace, and high-value
patterns crystallize into reusable Skills. At inference time, a three-tier
retriever (Skill → trace/episode → world model) injects the right context at
the right time.

## Layout (high-level)

```
apps/memos-local-plugin/
├── agent-contract/      # Stable types + JSON-RPC protocol shared with adapters
├── core/                # Agent-agnostic algorithm (memory, reward, retrieval, skill, hub, …)
├── server/              # HTTP + SSE server (powers the viewer)
├── bridge.cts + bridge/ # JSON-RPC bridge (used by Hermes Python adapter)
├── adapters/openclaw/   # In-process TS adapter for OpenClaw
├── adapters/hermes/     # Python adapter that talks to bridge.cts
├── adapters/deepseek-harness/ # In-process Cordis bundle for DSH
├── templates/           # config.yaml templates copied to the user's home on install
├── viewer/              # Runtime viewer (Vite, served by server/)
├── docs/                # Developer-facing docs (algorithm, data model, prompts, …)
├── scripts/             # Build / packaging / release helpers
└── tests/               # unit / integration / e2e (vitest)
```

For the full structural breakdown read [ARCHITECTURE.md](./ARCHITECTURE.md).

## Where data lives

Runtime code and user state stay separate. `install.sh` creates the OpenClaw
and Hermes homes; DSH installs the package into a profile with `dsh plugin`
and initializes its runtime home on first boot:


| Agent | Code installed to | Runtime data + config in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| OpenClaw | `~/.openclaw/plugins/memos-local-plugin/` | `~/.openclaw/memos-plugin/` |
| Hermes | `~/.hermes/plugins/memos-local-plugin/` | `~/.hermes/memos-plugin/` |
| DeepSeek Harness | Profile dependency managed by `dsh plugin` | `$DSH_HOME/memos-plugin/` (default `~/.dsh/memos-plugin/`) |


Inside the runtime folder:

```
config.yaml      # MemOS core config (includes API keys; chmod 600 when written)
data/memos.db    # SQLite (L1/L2/L3/Skill/Episode/Feedback/…)
skills/          # crystallized skill packages
logs/            # rotating logs (memos.log, error.log, audit.log, llm.jsonl, perf.jsonl, events.jsonl)
daemon/          # bridge pid/port files
```

An adapter creates only the directories it uses. DSH runs `MemoryCore` and the
existing HTTP/SSE Viewer in the DSH Node.js process, without a JSON-RPC bridge
or sidecar daemon. The Viewer listens on `http://127.0.0.1:18801` by default;
set `viewerEnabled: false` in the DSH Cordis row to run without that listener.
DSH still leaves MemOS file logging to the host, so its normal runtime surface
is an optional `config.yaml`, `data/`, and `skills/` when skills are produced.

Uninstalling the plugin does not delete `data/`, `skills/`, `logs/`, or
`config.yaml`. Startup after an upgrade may migrate the SQLite schema, so back
up the runtime directory before upgrading.

## Quick start

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Do not run `npm install -g @memtensor/memos-local-plugin`.**
> This is an agent plugin package, not a standalone CLI. A global
> npm install only downloads the published tarball into your `node_modules`
> tree; it does not wire OpenClaw, Hermes, or DSH. The tarball ships the built
> runtime plus the source and metadata required by the agent installers; the
> `viewer/` source, `website/`, tests, and other development-only files remain
> in this repository.
> Use `install.sh` / `install.ps1` for OpenClaw or Hermes. For DeepSeek
> Harness, use the Unix installer's `--agent dsh` target or DSH's
> lower-level `dsh plugin` command.

For OpenClaw and Hermes, the installer downloads the package from npm, deploys
it to the right agent directory, installs production dependencies, writes the
initial `config.yaml`, and restarts the agent runtime when needed.

From this repository:

```bash
cd apps/memos-local-plugin
bash install.sh --version 2.0.0
```

Or run against the latest published package:

```bash
bash install.sh
```

The installer auto-detects OpenClaw and Hermes. In an interactive terminal it
asks which agent to install for; in non-interactive environments it installs for
the detected agent(s). To test a local package before publishing, pass the
tarball path instead of a registry version:

```bash
npm pack
bash install.sh --version ./memtensor-memos-local-plugin-1.0.0-beta.1.tgz
```

For OpenClaw, use the installer for local archives too:

```bash
bash install.sh --agent openclaw --version ./memtensor-memos-local-plugin-2.0.16-beta.1.tgz
```

Do not substitute `openclaw plugins install ./package.tgz` for this command:
that raw-archive path can resolve development-only DeepSeek peer dependencies
and fail with `ERESOLVE`, including on OpenClaw 2026.9.1 and 2026.9.2.
The installer stages production dependencies and rebuilds `better-sqlite3`.
OpenClaw's newer `npm-pack:` path avoids the peer-resolution conflict, but a
successful managed install alone does not verify native bindings or initialize
MemOS runtime configuration; the installer above remains the supported setup.

When upgrading OpenClaw itself, migrate retired host configuration with
`openclaw doctor --fix` before installing MemOS. The MemOS installer removes its
own legacy `plugins.installs` records, preserves other plugins' old-host records,
and uses the host CLI for capability consent when available. It does not rewrite
the host's internal installation database. See
[the compatibility test results](docs/OPENCLAW-COMPATIBILITY.md) for tested versions
and limits.

On Windows, run `install.ps1` from PowerShell instead of `install.sh` for
OpenClaw or Hermes. The DSH one-command target currently supports macOS/Linux;
Windows users can use DSH's lower-level `dsh plugin` flow.

### DeepSeek Harness

DSH support is an out-of-tree Cordis bundle. The one-command installer keeps
DSH in control of its profile while handling pnpm's reviewed native dependency
build policy non-interactively. If `pnpm` is not already on `PATH`, it prepares
an isolated `pnpm@11.7.0` for that installer run without changing the user's
global package-manager setup:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MemTensor/MemOS/main/apps/memos-local-plugin/install.sh \
  | bash -s -- --agent dsh --profile web --version 2.0.16
```

The installer delegates package ownership and bundle reconciliation to
`dsh plugin`. If pnpm reports the reviewed build-script set, it enables
`better-sqlite3`, `esbuild`, `onnxruntime-node`, and `sharp`, explicitly
disables the unnecessary `protobufjs` and MemOS hint scripts, retries the same
package spec, and verifies the composed `memos-local-memory` row. Any unknown
build-script package fails closed for manual review; the installer never uses
`approve-builds --all`.

The temporary pnpm is removed when the installer exits. It is not needed for
normal `dsh --profile ...` runtime use. Users who later run lower-level
`dsh plugin` commands directly still need pnpm on `PATH`; install the DSH-pinned
version persistently with `npm install -g pnpm@11.7.0` if desired.

To develop from a local checkout instead, build it and add it to the desired
DSH profile directly:

```bash
cd /path/to/MemOS/apps/memos-local-plugin
npm install
npm run build:package
dsh plugin --profile web add .
```

The adapter reuses the provider/model and credentials already configured in
DSH for MemOS auxiliary L

plugins.description: Ghost-text next-prompt prediction in the DeepSeek Harness Web composer, accepted with Tab.
plugins.readme_text:
# Prompt Forecast

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Ghost-text prediction of your next action in the DeepSeek Harness Web composer,
in the style of Codex and Claude Code prompt suggestions.

After a completed turn the Host half asks the session's own model for the single
most likely next actionable message, publishes it through a client-visible
session projection, and the Client half renders it as gray text on the first line
of an empty composer. Press **Tab** or **→** to accept it into the draft, or
**Esc** to ignore that suggestion. Typing anything hides it; the text you typed is
never replaced.

The default mode is a Codex-style context fork: the parent's current text
transcript plus one synthetic user turn, `Suggest my next message.`, with
explicit rules that restrict the answer to an action.

## Requirements

- **DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` or newer within `0.2.x`**, declared as `engines.dsh: ^0.2.1-rc.2`.
- This plugin is built on the 0.2.1-rc.2 client and Host surfaces: the
  `conversation.input.overlay` composer slot, `InputActions.captureInsertion()` /
  `insertText()`, and the session-projection carrier fed by `agent/turn-stopping`.
- `dsh plugin add` validates the range during installation and restores the
  previous profile state when it does not match; profile startup checks it
  again. An unmet range refuses to load the plugin; upgrade DSH or install a
  plugin release whose `engines.dsh` matches your runtime. A DSH `0.3` release
  will need a matching plugin release rather than an exemption.

## What it does

- Fork mode (default) predicts from the full text transcript; digest mode uses a
  compact JSON excerpt.
- Predicts the next action, not a status report or an outcome guess.
- Writes in the language the user writes in, one short line.
- Uses the route that served the turn (falling back to the profile default
  model), so no extra provider setup is required.
- Skips subagent sessions and turns with no human input.
- Fails silently: a slow, aborted, or failed prediction never surfaces an error
  in the conversation.

## What gets predicted

The target is the next **actionable** message, not a literal continuation of the
conversation. A useful suggestion is one the user would send to tell the
assistant what to do next:

- an instruction: run the tests, fix this error, check the projection cache,
  explain the failure
- a choice or approval: use option A, go ahead, keep it
- a correction: no, change the client side
- a request to explain or diagnose: why does the fork call time out?
- a short report followed by an instruction: restarted, still empty — check the
  logs

Pure status reports, test results, log observations, narration, and guesses about
what might happen are rejected; `NONE` is a valid answer. A conservative
post-filter drops obvious pure-report clauses, and fork mode falls back to the
digest when the result is unusable.

## Prediction modes

`mode: 'fork'` (default) mirrors the Codex composer-prediction shape. It takes
the session's current text transcript — system and developer instructions plus
user/assistant text — drops tool calls, tool results, reasoning, and attachment
blocks, then appends one synthetic user turn:

```text
Suggest my next message.
```

The model's reply becomes the ghost line. No child session or session event is
created; the fork is an in-memory message list for one auxiliary call. A short
action-rules block is appended to the inherited system prompt so the model writes
the user's next instruction rather than a status report. Because the whole
transcript is sent, this mode costs more tokens and needs a larger `timeoutMs`
than the digest mode.

`mode: 'digest'` keeps the earlier lightweight path: a compact JSON excerpt
(`recent_user_messages`, `latest_assistant_reply`, `tools_used`) with a short,
action-oriented system prompt. Use it for cheap predictions or long sessions
where sending the transcript is too expensive.

## Configuration

The row's `config` block in `cordis.patch.yml` overrides every default:

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | `false` leaves the Host half unregistered |
| `mode` | `fork` | `fork` = full transcript + `Suggest my next message.`; `digest` = compact JSON excerpt |
| `maxTokens` | `1024` | Output budget of the prediction request |
| `temperature` | `0.4` | Sampling temperature |
| `timeoutMs` | `12000` | Hard bound on the request; a slower answer is dropped |
| `maxPromptChars` | `80` | Clip length of the predicted prompt |
| `maxForkChars` | `12000` | Character budget of the forked conversation window (system/developer text is always kept) |
| `fallback` | `true` | When the fork yields no text, retry with the compact digest |
| `maxInputChars` | `6000` | Digest-mode excerpt size bound |
| `skipSubagents` | `true` | Subagent sessions get no prediction |
| `provider` | turn route | Explicit provider override |
| `model` | turn route | Explicit model override |

The prediction is produced while the turn boundary is still open
(`agent/turn-stopping`), so its text arrives with the finished turn instead of
requiring a poll. `timeoutMs` is the price: a prediction that does not settle
within that budget is dropped and the turn finishes without one.

## Install

### From GitHub (no build step)

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:littepointR/dsh-prompt-forecast
dsh web
```

`dsh plugin add` forwards to pnpm in the chosen profile, installs the package,
and automatically adds the bundle to `dsh.profile.bundles` because the package
declares `dsh.bundle.patch`. Restart the profile for the plugin to load. The
package is plain JavaScript with no `prepare` build script, so a git install
needs no extra pnpm build approval.

To pin the tagged release:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:littepointR/dsh-prompt-forecast#v0.2.4
```

The Desktop application's `desktop` profile is reserved for the Electron app, so
the CLI rejects `--profile desktop`. Use Settings → Plugins there, or install
into a CLI profile.

### From a local checkout

Use Plugin Manager with this package directory as the bundle target. The bundle
patch inserts the `prompt-forecast` row; it survives restarts because it is a
normal profile bundle.

## Limits

- Only an empty composer shows a suggestion. Completing a partially typed draft
  needs caret geometry the slot does not expose yet and is not part of this
  version.
- The suggestion is a hint, not an action: accepting inserts plain text into the
  draft and nothing is sent.
- Prediction quality depends on the session model; a very small model may return
  a generic follow-up.

## Development

```bash
node --test test/host.test.mjs test/client.test.mjs
node --check index.js && node --check client.js
```

- `index.js` — Host half: generate at `agent/turn-stopping`, publish through the
  `promptForecast` projection.
- `client.js` — Client half: register in `conversation.input.overlay`, render the
  ghost line, handle Tab/→/Esc.
- `test/host.test.mjs` — text normalization, digest building, projection fold.
- `test/client.test.mjs` — structural smoke test of the Client render branches
  (no DOM emulation).

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Liquid-glass skin for DeepSeek Harness: layered glass surfaces, time-of-day wallpapers, theme color and per-layer controls. · DSH 液态玻璃皮肤插件
plugins.readme_text:
# Liquid Glass for DeepSeek Harness

A layered liquid-glass skin for the DSH web UI. Sidebar, conversation column, right rail, pages,
composer, conversation header and settings menus are re-materialised as glass; the page background
becomes a wallpaper that rotates with the time of day; a small sun button in the bottom-right corner
opens the control panel.

Every glass surface is generated by one contract (displacement map → blur → contrast → brightness →
saturation → rim), so any layer at any setting is the same material as the sample capsule.

## What you get

- **13 adjustable glass regions** — sidebar, conversation column, right rail, in-column pages, home
  hero, composer, question card, conversation header, selection highlight, new-session rows, composer
  controls, dialogs & menus, and the draggable sample capsule.
- **14 knobs per region** — tint, tint saturation, concentration, blur, contrast, brightness,
  saturation, rim strength, displacement scale, chromatic aberration and friends. Every knob actually
  moves something; there are no dead sliders.
- **Time-of-day wallpapers** — three bundled images rotate by clock (04:00–11:59 / 12:00–17:59 /
  18:00–03:59), re-checked every 30 s. Four more bundled images ship as ordinary wallpapers: pick one
  to pin it, delete it, or upload your own. Uploads and deletes are written to disk.
- **Four theme colours** — official DeepSeek blue (default), gold, white, black. Applied to the host
  colour ramp and to the new-session layer.
- **Selection highlight** — the active sidebar row or settings nav cell carries glass; switching sends
  a lens flying from the old position to the new one (spring, stretch, trail).
- **Scheme-aware concentration** — tint concentration and brightness follow the light/dark scheme on
  the seven large surfaces, so a light scheme does not get a heavy wash.
- **Bundled font** — HarmonyOS Sans SC (three weights) is served from the package and published as
  `--dsw-font-family`; nothing is installed system-wide and uninstalling removes it.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin add @istarry/dsh-ui-liquid-glass
```

Then restart the DSH service (fully quit the desktop app, or restart `dsh web`).

## Use

Click the sun button in the bottom-right corner:

- **主题 / Theme** — wallpapers, theme colour, text colour.
- **控件 / Controls** — one tab per region, 14 knobs each, plus a shared sample capsule.

Every value persists automatically. There is a reset per page and a full reset.

## Permissions and behaviour

Read this before installing — the plugin is not a passive stylesheet:

- **Writes to disk.** It creates `~/.dsh/ui-liquid-glass/wallpapers` on first activation and seeds it
  with the bundled wallpapers, adding only files that are missing (never overwriting yours). The
  `Default/` subfolder is kept in sync with the bundled rotation set and is pruned; the root of that
  folder is yours and is never pruned.
- **Serves HTTP routes** on the host web server: `GET /ui-liquid-glass/wallpapers` (list),
  `GET /ui-liquid-glass/wallpapers/<name>` (bytes), `POST` / `DELETE` on the same path (add / remove),
  and `GET /ui-liquid-glass/fonts/<file>` for the bundled font. Hosts without a web server never
  resolve these routes; the picker then hides upload/delete.
- **Overrides host CSS tokens.** It publishes `--lg-*` variables, remaps a number of official
  `--dsw-*` tokens (backgrounds, menu surfaces, hover fills) and sets `--dsw-font-family`. Everything
  is scoped under `body[data-lg-skin]`, so removing the plugin restores the official look.
- **Stores preferences in localStorage** under `ui-liquid-glass/skin/v4` (browser side only).

## Compatibility

- Tested against DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`.
- Peer dependency: `@deepseek-ai/cordis` `^4.0.1`.
- The client half is a self-contained bundle and declares no `dsh.client.inject`; it hooks only
  official CSS tokens, official layout local names, and ARIA roles.

## Bundled assets and licences

- **HarmonyOS Sans SC** — Copyright 2021 Huawei Device Co., Ltd. Redistributed unmodified under the
  HarmonyOS Sans Fonts License Agreement, which permits bundling with software. The full licence is at
  `assets/fonts/LICENSE_Fonts.txt`. The font files must not be modified or redistributed standalone.
- **Wallpapers** — bundled for demonstration. If you repackage or redistribute this plugin, replace
  them with images you have the rights to.

## Building from source

The repository ships prebuilt `lib/` output, so installing from the repository never runs a build.
To rebuild locally you need a DSH source checkout — `tsconfig.json` extends the host's
`tsconfig.base.client.json` and `tsdown.config.ts` imports the host's client preset:

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm exec tsc -b .
pnpm exec tsdown
```

The package name in `tsdown.config.ts` is written into the emitted bundle
(`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id })`) — renaming the package means editing that file and rebuilding.

## License

MIT. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.description: 黎猫工具箱：DSH 快捷栏、起始页、对话框与模型设置、消息通知、插件管理及 Windows 启动保护。 | Modular DeepSeek Harness UI enhancements, notifications, model controls and plugin management.
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-tanuki-toolbox · 黎猫工具箱 **简体中文** · [English](README.en.md) 为 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）** 提供可独立开关的界面与交互增强：快捷栏、起始页、对话框、模型设置、消息通知与插件管理，并提供 Windows 启动保护。支持日间／夜间主题，随 DSH 语言切换中文或英文。 当前版本：**0.7.9**。包含重新设计的模型设置、兼容中枢的速度控制，以及长按 1 秒触发的 Windows 后台保护重启。本项目为社区插件，非 DeepSeek 官方产品。 ## 安装 在 DSH 的「插件 → 添加插件」中填写仓库地址： ```text https://github.com/TanukiRei/tanuki-toolbox ``` 安装后启用「黎猫工具箱」，再按需要开关各组件。仓库包含构建结果，不需要在安装时编译。直接填写仓库地址需要本机可用的 Git；如果电脑没有 Git，请使用 [最新 Release 说明](https://github.com/TanukiRei/tanuki-toolbox/releases/latest)中的「免 Git 安装地址」。这个地址直接从 GitHub 下载指定提交，插件市场也能据此识别仓库更新。 本项目保留包名 `dsh-local-plugin-center`。从旧版本更新时请直接安装上述地址，无需卸载，以保留现有组件设置。离线安装包见 [Releases](https://github.com/TanukiRei/tanuki-toolbox/releases)。 ## 组件 工具箱默认提供模型屏蔽功能：启用“设置优化 → 模型”后，在 **设置 → 模型** 的服务和模型行旁管理开关。关闭后从 DSH 模型目录和选择列表隐藏，并在宿主请求准备及实际派发前拦截。已有对话仍选中该模型时，仅为该对话保留灰色、不可再选择的占位项，禁止发送并显示“该模型已禁用”；切换其他模型后移除占位并恢复发送。不会自动切换其他模型，已在发送中的请求不强制中断，草稿保留。限制保存在当前 profile，重新开启即可恢复；限制执行属于默认功能，关闭设置优化也不会清除已保存的开关，关闭工具箱本体后不再拦截。 设置标题旁显示 DSH 版本；“打开配置文件”左侧的“更新系统”按钮打开原生更新流程，没有可用更新时显示灰色“已是最新”。此入口属于默认功能；设置入口的更新气泡由消息中心的“系统更新”与全局气泡开关控制。 | 组件 | 功能 | | --- | --- | | 启动保护 | 保护启动前检查明确声明的版本不兼容，停用符合条件的第三方插件；Windows 支持快捷方式保护和登录后自启动。 | | 快捷栏 | 编辑左侧入口的顺序与显示状态；工作区可收起、拖动调整宽度并保存，支持一键重启。 | | 起始页 | 查看日期、对话／任务概览、昨日已记录 Token、近期活动与受支持的账号额度。 | | 对话框优化 | 时间统计、模型与推理等级卡片、受支持的速度控制，以及任务文件的右键操作。 | | 设置优化 | 紧凑的模型管理，支持服务与模型排序、开关、默认选择及独立编辑弹窗。 | | 消息中心 | 顶部灵动岛、系统通知、持久气泡与提示音；可按来源控制通知和对应气泡。 | | 插件中心 | 区分官方与第三方插件，提供搜索、版本号、自定义名称、更新入口及「插件市场」集成。 | Windows 的一键重启长按 1 秒触发。后台程序确认当前实例与重开入口后先关闭 DSH，再通过原有保护入口完成检查并重新打开；没有额外的固定等待，也不自动重试。请在任务与插件安装完成后使用。 组件按需加载；关闭组件不会在冷启动时预载该组件的功能代码。已加载模块可能仍保留在引擎缓存中，详见 [生命周期说明](LIFECYCLE.txt)。工具箱自有界面跟随 DSH 的语言：简体、繁体及其他 `zh` 中文变体统一使用中文，其他语言统一使用英文；不改写 DSH 的语言设置。第三方插件与用户内容保留原始文本。 消息中心的“允许通知”使用插件、任务、系统更新三个按钮，点亮为绿色，悬停可查看说明；系统更新专指 DSH 本体更新。灵动岛、系统通知、全局气泡与提示音分别开关。关闭灵动岛只隐藏应用内顶部消息，不影响其余通道，重新开启不补播旧消息。通知来源按钮同时控制对应提醒和气泡：关闭“插件”隐藏插件入口、插件详情及“更新全部”等相关气泡，关闭“任务”隐藏任务相关气泡；重新开启后恢复当前仍有效的状态。全局气泡总开关仍需开启，气泡状态颜色不变。安全启动确认属于一般消息，点击进入“插件中心 → 已安装 → 第三方”。 启用“设置优化 → 模型”后，顶部可添加服务并选择默认模型及推理等级；对话框的还原按钮读取该默认选择。服务和模型使用侧栏同款六点手柄，拖动使用指针捕获并以白色横线提示插入位置，回到原行也保留提示，可用 Alt＋上下键调整；顺序持久保存并同步到对话框选择列表，停用不改变原位置。名称和开关等列表操作自动保存；服务的密钥、名称、地址、协议和模型详细参数分别在弹窗中编辑，提供保存、取消及未保存提示。恢复默认模型和获取可用模型保留独立按钮，不再显示底部重复的“模型启用”模块。推理等级保留 DSH 自带翻译。 设置窗口首次打开后保留当前页面和页面状态，关闭改为带动画隐藏，再次点击设置继续上次页面；隐藏期间移除焦点约束，模型页停止自己的读取订阅。此行为属于默认功能，没有额外组件开关。应用退出或工具箱停用时仍释放窗口。 在模型设置中选定默认值后，该值单独保存并固定；会话中临时切换模型或推理等级只影响该会话，不再覆盖固定默认值。新会话与还原按钮使用固定默认，DSH 原生配置也同步该选择。 灵动岛消息从应用顶部进入，每条显示 8 秒，最多同时保留最新两条；新消息将旧消息向下推，第三条会挤出最旧消息。悬停不暂停倒计时。插件中心提供昵称/原名搜索，官方插件以等高卡片区分正式版与实验性插件；更新查询状态只在插件中心显示文字。 组件关闭后自动收起细分设置；重新展开查看时，下属选项变灰且不可修改，已保存的子项选择保留。 主页提供日期、对话/任务概览、昨日已记录 Token、近七天活动、最近对话与当前任务。已启用且登录 Codex 订阅插件时可读取其额度；统计范围与缺失值说明见页面及变更记录。 ## 更新 安装并启用「插件市场」后，可以在插件中心查看仓库发布的更新并点击更新。经所有者明确要求发布后，才同步到 `main`，并保留版本标签和 `.tgz` 发布包；版本规则见 [VERSIONING.txt](VERSIONING.txt)。不会后台静默安装更新。 ## 兼容性 包声明支持 DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0`。部分界面功能依赖 DSH 当前页面结构，宿主更新后可能需要适配。快捷方式接管、登录自启动和强制重启工具用于 Windows；macOS 会禁用这些专用操作，并保留运行中明确版本不兼容插件检查。Mac 界面按窗口/全屏状态避让标题栏，系统通知激活使用系统应用打开机制。 启动保护仅检查明确声明的版本不兼容，不保证拦截未声明的运行时故障。直接启动 DSH 原始程序不会经过快捷方式保护；Windows 缓存的固定入口可能需要重新固定。 ## 开发 ```text node scripts/build.cjs ``` 该命令使用仓库内的模板和资源重新生成 `client.js` 与 `client-chunks/`，无需安装构建依赖。保护启动器的 C# 源码和 Windows 可执行文件一起保留；需要修改启动器时运行 `scripts/build-launcher.ps1`。单次重启程序使用 `scripts/build-restart-worker.ps1` 编译，并同时生成源码/二进制摘要；普通构建仅核对摘要，不执行重启。 详细变更记录见 [README.txt](README.txt)，全局消息接口见 [NOTIFICATIONS.txt](NOTIFICATIONS.txt)。遵循项目默认偏好，未明确要求时不运行功能测试；构建与打包不代表功能验收。 采用 [MIT 许可证](LICENSE)。本项目为社区插件，非 DeepSeek 官方产品。 ## 速度接口接入 开启“设置优化 → 模型”后，兼容 OpenAI Chat Completions 的服务可读取 `{baseURL}/models` 的 `capabilities.service_tiers`。只有明确包含 `priority` 或 `fast` 的直接模型显示速度选择；服务商 ID 和完整模型 ID 保持原样。展开服务可点击“重新读取速度能力”；“获取可用模型”也会同步读取能力。模型卡片的闪电按钮直接切换“标准／快速”，未启用模型卡片时显示于原生模型选择旁。标准明确发送 `service_tier=default`，快速发送 `priority`；默认/还原保留继承中枢（省略速度参数），首次点击明确请求快速。偏好按会话、提供商和模型保存，每轮任务捕获快照；重试、工具续写和继承的子任务不受其他会话改档影响。 按与接口方确认的契约，服务端强制速度策略优先；服务端设置为默认时，使用 DSH 请求的标准或快速。点亮的蓝色实心闪电表示 DSH 请求快速，配色与推理等级一致；实际执行档位以接口返回为准。 闪电按钮的悬停说明显示中枢 SSE 的实际确认：未返回实际档位时只显示“等待确认／未确认”，不会把按钮点亮当作上游已生效。凭据仅由 DSH 宿主读取；能力失败保留配置并提供重读入口，不切换其他账号或模型。此接入需要中枢实际返回上述扩展字段；纯标准目录或不兼容协议不会凭名称开启快速选项。本版本只做构建与静态核查，尚未完成真实中枢联调。

plugins.description: DSH 插件：Manim 动画工作室 —— 把论文/方法渲成带配音的讲解视频（manim_scene / manim_render / manim_frames / manim_voice）
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-manim · 动画工作室

把论文、方法或任何流程说明渲染成**带旁白的讲解视频**，全程在编辑器里完成。 一个 DSH 插件，提供： - 左侧栏「动画」入口 + 右侧栏「动画工作室」面板（场景列表 / 画质 / 渲染 / 播放 / 分镜 / 实时日志） - 四个 agent 工具：`manim_scene` · `manim_render` · `manim_frames` · `manim_voice` - 一份随包 skill `manim-explainer`：怎么把一篇论文拆成 4–8 拍、版式与节奏纪律、常见坑 - 成片 `.mp4` 在右侧栏文件树里点开就能播（本插件注册了视频预览渲染器；官方自带的预览集不含视频） 渲染器是 [Manim](https://www.manim.community/) 0.22，装在插件自己的虚拟环境里，不碰系统 Python。 旁白用系统/在线 TTS，**不需要下载任何语音模型**。 --- ## 预览 左侧对话里说一句「把这个做成动画视频」，右侧「动画工作室」自己出现在工作区里：场景列表、画质、 渲染与取消、成片播放器、分镜条、实时日志都在一个面板里。 ![动画工作室面板](docs/panel-preview.png) ### 示例成片 下面这条 **78 秒讲解片**（1920×1080 @ 60fps，含中文旁白）就是用它做的 —— 把一个方法拆成 8 拍：问题 → 为什么难 → 核心想法 → 两条支路 → 结果， 公式用 `mathtex()` 排版（不需要 LaTeX），旁白先出、画面按每句时长对拍。 [![示例成片：一个方法讲成 8 拍](docs/demo-poster.png)](docs/demo-sample.mp4) > 点封面播放（`docs/demo-sample.mp4`）。示例内容基于已发表论文 *UNETR++*（IEEE TMI 2024）的公开方法。 --- ## 环境要求 | 需要 | 版本 / 说明 | |---|---| | Node.js | `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24` | | Python | ≥ 3.10，**只用来创建插件自己的 venv**（不会往你的解释器里装东西） | | DSH 宿主 | 本插件是 DSH 插件（注册侧边栏槽位 + agent 工具），需要宿主才能运行 | **不需要装的东西**（这是本插件刻意设计的）： | 不需要 | 为什么 | |---|---| | **LaTeX / TeX 发行版** | 公式走 `manimkit.mathtex()`（matplotlib 的 mathtext 引擎），不需要 `latex`、不需要 `dvisvgm`。检测到可用 LaTeX 时会自动升级成真正的 `MathTex`，但没有也完全能用 | | **ffmpeg** | manim 0.22 用 PyAV 在进程内编码；旁白的 mp3 也由 PyAV 转成 WAV | | **任何语音模型** | 旁白走 Edge 朗读（联网、免费、免 key）或 Windows SAPI（离线） | | **额外的 npm 运行时依赖** | 两侧只用宿主已提供的包（`react`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-*` 由 DSH 宿主注入）；`npm install` 装的只是构建与测试用的 devDependencies | --- ## 安装 ```bash git clone https://github.com/Strivy-ZSY/dsh-manim.git cd dsh-manim npm install # 只为构建与测试装 esbuild / react（运行时不需要） npm run setup:runtime # 建 runtime/venv，装 manim 0.22 + matplotlib 与 manimkit 的路径 npm run build # src/ → lib/（面板 bundle + 宿主半边） ``` `npm run setup:runtime` 可用参数： ```bash node runtime/setup-runtime.mjs --check # 只检查，不安装 node runtime/setup-runtime.mjs --python # 指定基础解释器 ``` ### 网络不稳时怎么装（`ERR_PNPM_GIT_FETCH_FAILED` / `SSL_ERROR_SYSCALL` / `early EOF`） 这些是 **GitHub 传输链路**的报错，不是仓库坏了。按顺序试，通常第 1 条就够： **1. 让 git 容忍慢链路** ```bash git config --global http.version HTTP/1.1 git config --global http.postBuffer 524288000 git config --global http.lowSpeedLimit 0 git config --global http.lowSpeedTime 999999 # 再重跑 pnpm add ``` 后两条是关键：`early EOF` / `SSL_ERROR_SYSCALL` 多半是链路被限速后 git 自己判超时。 **2. 给 pnpm 更多耐心** ```bash pnpm add https://github.com/Strivy-ZSY/dsh-manim --fetch-retries=5 --fetch-timeout=600000 ``` **3. 走镜像**（把 `github.com` 换成镜像主机，任选其一） ```bash pnpm add https://ghfast.top/https://github.com/Strivy-ZSY/dsh-manim.git pnpm add https://gitclone.com/github.com/Strivy-ZSY/dsh-manim.git ``` **4. 用压缩包代替 git 协议**（少一次协议握手，通常最稳） ```bash pnpm add https://ghfast.top/https://github.com/Strivy-ZSY/dsh-manim/archive/refs/heads/main.tar.gz ``` > 仓库里带了一段 7.6 MB 的演示视频（`docs/demo-sample.mp4`，只用于 README 展示，安装不需要它）， > 所以 clone 的体积比代码本身大。链路很窄时，第 4 条最省事。 ### 面板从哪里打开 插件**不在左侧栏加自己的一行**：官方客户端的左栏是它自己的（插件 / 自动化任务 / …）， 第三方插件塞一行进去显得突兀。面板作为**右侧栏的一个 tab** 注册，通过右侧栏的标签页 控件或「开始」页里的入口打开。 如果你的宿主只能在左栏列出插件，可以在 profile patch 里显式要求那一行： ```yaml - id: dsh-manim name: 'dsh-manim' config: sidebarEntry: true # 默认 false；宿主把插件配置传给浏览器半边时生效 ``` ### 装进 DSH **官方客户端（推荐）** —— 侧栏「插件」→「添加插件」，把仓库地址贴进「包名或地址」→ 安装 → 启用： ``` https://github.com/Strivy-ZSY/dsh-manim ``` 本仓库是一个**组合包（bundle）**：`package.json` 里声明 `dsh.bundle.patch`，随包带一份 `cordis.patch.yml`。DSH 安装后按**包名**插入一行并挂载浏览器半边，**不需要手改任何 profile 文件**。 **本地开发**（`pnpm add <本地目录>`，或手工在 profile patch 里加一行）： ```yaml - insert: - id: dsh-manim name: 'dsh-manim' # 必须是包名：浏览器半边只认「行说明符 === 包名」 ``` **首次使用还要建渲染运行时**（一次性，约 500 MB 的 Python 依赖，装进插件自己的 `runtime/venv`）： ```bash cd <安装目录>/node_modules/dsh-manim node runtime/setup-runtime.mjs ``` 装好后：左侧栏出现「动画」行，右侧栏出现「动画工作室」tab，四个 `manim_*` 工具进入会话工具表。 运行时没建时面板会报「运行时未就绪」并给出解释器路径 —— 跑上面那条命令即可，不需要重装插件。 --- ## 用法 **面板**：点「动画」→ 选一个场景文件（扫整个工作区的 `.py`）→ 选画质 → 渲染。 渲染完可拖动播放、点分镜条跳到某一刻；日志实时滚动，可随时取消。 **会话里**： ```python manim_scene(action='template', name='MyExplainer') # 从模板起一个场景 manim_render(path='animations/MyExplainer.py', quality='draft') manim_frames(path='animations/MyExplainer.py', count=6) manim_voice(action='list') # 看可用音色 ``` 工作顺序建议 **audio-first**：先出旁白拿到每句时长，再写画面。 ### 配音 `manim_voice` 提供两条路，`engine='auto'` 优先第一条： | 引擎 | 音质 | 需要什么 | 音色 | |---|---|---|---| | `edge` | 接近真人 | 联网，免费、免 key | 14 个中文，含 `zh-CN-XiaoxiaoNeural` | | `sapi` | 机械 | 完全离线（Windows） | `Microsoft Huihui Desktop` 等 | 生成 `animations/voice/*.wav` + `cues.json`（每句的 `at` 与 `duration`），场景里两行挂上： ```python from manimkit import find_cue_sheet, hold, narration def construct(self): sheet = find_cue_sheet("voice/cues.json") cues = narration(self, sheet) if sheet is not None else None self.play(Write(title), run_time=1.0) if cues is not None: hold(self, cues, "b1") # 画面撑到第 1 句说完 ``` `narration()` 按 cue sheet 自己的位置解析路径，从哪渲染都不会失联。 不想用 TTS 就直接替换 `cues.json` 与音频文件（结构 `{"cues":[{"id","text","file","duration","at"}]}`），场景代码一个字都不用改。 --- ## 公式：为什么不需要 LaTeX manim 自带的 `Tex` / `MathTex` 会 `shell out` 到 `latex` 再 `dvisvgm`——这个组合要求一整套 TeX 发行版，在很多机器上缺失或损坏（Windows 尤其常见），一旦缺了就在第一个公式处抛 `ValueError: latex error converting to dvi`。 所以本插件默认用 `manimkit.mathtex()`：走 matplotlib 的 mathtext（就是画 `$…$` 轴标签那个引擎）， 支持 `\frac` `\sqrt` `\sum` `\int` `\mathbb` `\mathcal` `\hat`、上下标、`\left(`/`\right)`， **不需要任何外部程序**。它渲染成透明底 PNG 再包成 `ImageMobject`。 - 若机器上确实有可用的 LaTeX，`has_latex()` 会自动改走真正的 `MathTex`，场景文件不用改 - 可用 `DSH_MANIM_TEX=1` / `=0` 强制开关 - `mathtex()` 里**不要写中文**（matplotlib 数学字体没有 CJK，会画成空框）——中文用 `text()` 单独放 --- ## 目录 ``` src/ config.ts 配置 + 画质预设 + 默认解释器路径 engine.ts 渲染引擎：spawn 驱动、读 NDJSON 事件、任务表 service.ts 工作区门控、场景扫描、渲染编排、抽帧、模板 routes.ts /dsh-manim 路由（POST JSON + GET Range 流） tools.ts manim_scene / manim_render / manim_frames / manim_voice skills.ts 把 skills/**/SKILL.md 交给 skill 注册表 index.ts apply()：路由 + 工具 + skill + 正向 attach 标记 client/ 面板：studio.tsx / panel-row.tsx / 图标 / i18n runtime/ setup-runtime.mjs 建 venv、装 manim + matplotlib、写 manimkit 的 .pth engine/driver.py 渲染驱动：plan / render / list / frames / probe，stdout 为 NDJSON manimkit/ 主题与版式：theme.py / mathkit.py / layout.py templates/starter.py 起始场景（面板的「新场景」与 manim_scene(template) 共用） skills/manim-explainer/ 方法：怎么拆拍、版式与节奏纪律、常见坑 tools/ build.mjs / test-offline.mjs / check-panel-markup.mjs ``` ### 为什么自带虚拟环境 插件不往系统解释器里装东西：`runtime/venv` 由 `setup-runtime.mjs` 建一次，之后渲染是确定性的。 `manim==0.22.0` 钉在 requirements 里，换机器结果一致；你的 numpy / scipy / opencv 不受影响。 ### 为什么驱动单独写 `runtime/engine/driver.py` 不是 `python -m manim render` 的包装： 1. **媒体目录归插件管** —— 不会往工作区写 `./media/…`，工作区只收到一个 `.mp4` 2. **进度机器可读** —— 每段动画边界与动画内 ~0.25 秒发一个 NDJSON 事件，面板才有真正的进度条 3. **有 plan 阶段** —— 关绘制 + 1fps 先把 `construct()` 跑一遍，几秒内量出段数与总时长， 长渲染之前先快速失败 4. **不依赖 PATH 上的 ffmpeg** 事件契约写在 `driver.py` 模块注释里，改任何一边都要同步。 --- ## 配置 patch 里可覆盖的键（全部有默认值，`config: {}` 也能跑）： | 键 | 默认 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | `agentTools` | 四个全开 | 暴露给模型的工具；`'*'` 或 `[]` | | `pythonPath` | `runtime/venv/Scripts/python.exe` | 换解释器（Linux/macOS 为 `runtime/venv/bin/python`） | | `driverPath` | `runtime/engine/driver.py` | 换驱动 | | `cacheDir` | `<插件>/cache` | 渲染缓存（manim 的 partial_movie 也在里面） | | `outputDir` | `animations` | 成片复制到工作区哪个子目录；`''` = 不复制 | | `background` | `#10141c` | 场景背景色 | | `defaultQuality` | `1080p60` | 默认画质 | | `maxSceneBytes` | 512 KB | 超过此大小的 `.py` 不扫描 | | `jobTtlSeconds` | 1800 | 任务记录保留时长 | |

plugins.description: QiuYa 增强工具箱：为 DeepSeek Harness 添加长文本附件、会话独立窗口、批量归档和计划批注。
plugins.readme_text:
# QiuYa 增强工具箱

给 DeepSeek Harness 加一点顺手的小功能。

## 安装

1. 打开 Harness 的 **插件 → 添加插件**。
2. 输入 npm 包名 **`dsh-qiuya-tools`**，点击安装。
3. 点击 **立即启用**，进入 **设置 → QiuYaTools**。

左下角账号菜单也有 QiuYaTools 入口。[查看 npm 包](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-qiuya-tools)。

也可在“添加插件”中粘贴 GitHub 安装包链接：

```text
https://github.com/z1223473749/dsh-QiuYaTools/releases/latest/download/dsh-qiuya-tools.tgz
```

镜像源同步新版本可能稍有延迟。暂时找不到包或新版本时，可稍后重试、切换到 [npm 官方源](https://registry.npmjs.org/)，或使用上面的 GitHub 链接。

## 功能

| 功能 | 怎么用 |
| --- | --- |
| 长文本附件 | 粘贴长文本自动转为 TXT，默认 1000 个字符或 15 行，阈值可调。 |
| 会话独立窗口 | 右键打开，或把会话拖出列表；再次打开同一会话会唤起已有窗口。 |
| 批量归档 | Shift 连选、⌘ / Ctrl 多选后右键归档，也可归档工作区全部会话。 |
| 计划批注 | 选中计划文字添加评论，提交修改建议，保留输入框原有草稿。 |
| 会话菜单 | 右键置顶、手动标记已读 / 未读、复制标题 / 会话 ID / 工作目录路径、打开目录；工作区也可移到顶部。 |
| 提示词建议 | 回复结束且输入框为空时，根据当前会话推荐下一句，失焦仍保留。聚焦后按 **Tab** 填入、**Esc** 隐藏，可修改后手动发送。 |
| Q主题「鲸与海」 | 手绘鲸鱼与白发少年背景，搭配柔和的半透明界面，支持浅色、深色外观。 |

六项增强默认开启，可单独开关，也可一键全选。Q主题默认关闭，独立设置。功能入口分为两排，无需横向滚动。

提示词建议使用当前会话所选模型，会产生少量额外模型用量。

## 界面预览

主题截图来自实际使用界面；设置页和提示词演示使用隔离示例。

**Q主题 · 新会话**

![Q主题鲸与海的新会话界面](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/z1223473749/dsh-QiuYaTools/main/docs/images/q-theme-home.png)

**Q主题 · 会话阅读**

![Q主题半透明会话与输入框](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/z1223473749/dsh-QiuYaTools/main/docs/images/q-theme-conversation.png)

**功能设置**

![QiuYaTools 双排功能入口与长文本转换阈值](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/z1223473749/dsh-QiuYaTools/main/docs/images/settings.jpg)

**Q主题设置**

![QiuYaTools 鲸与海主题设置与预览](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/z1223473749/dsh-QiuYaTools/main/docs/images/q-theme.jpg)

**提示词建议**

空输入框显示当前会话的建议，聚焦后按 Tab 填入。以下用示例回复演示交互，不调用真实模型。

![QiuYaTools 灰字提示词与 Tab 填入示例](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/z1223473749/dsh-QiuYaTools/main/docs/images/prompt-suggestions.jpg)

## 更新与兼容

在 **QiuYaTools → 版本更新 → 检查更新** 中升级，完成后完全退出并重新打开 Harness，原有设置保留。

当前适配官方 macOS Harness **0.2.1-rc.2**。独立窗口需要 **macOS 13+**，安装包包含 Apple Silicon 和 Intel 组件。

[npm 包](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-qiuya-tools) · [发布版本](https://github.com/z1223473749/dsh-QiuYaTools/releases) · [问题反馈](https://github.com/z1223473749/dsh-QiuYaTools/issues) · [使用与开发](https://github.com/z1223473749/dsh-QiuYaTools/blob/main/docs/development.md) · [www.qiuya.cc](https://www.qiuya.cc)

# dsh-control-center

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Three visual Settings pages for the DeepSeek Harness: **MCP servers**, **skills**
and **global personas**. One dual-face plugin — a host half that owns the data
and the one model-facing contribution, and a browser half that renders the
pages into the settings shell.

> The Chinese document ([README.zh.md](README.zh.md)) is the fuller one: it adds
> the verification log, troubleshooting, and the one-click script reference.

```
Settings
├── …
├── MCP 管理          MCP server CRUD
├── Skill 管理        author or pull skills, inspect and delete them
└── 全局人设          a library of persona documents, one active
```

## Install

The package is a normal DSH bundle. Any channel works.

**One script (Windows).** Copies the package, backs the patch up once, and
writes the marked mount block — idempotent, `-DryRun` to preview, `-Profile` /
`-DshHome` to target another profile:

```powershell
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\install.ps1
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\uninstall.ps1   # one-key restore
```

**Official CLI**, which also records the bundle in the profile manifest:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-control-center
```

**By hand**, for a profile whose `node_modules` is managed manually: copy this
directory to `<profile>/node_modules/dsh-control-center`, then append the mount
row to the profile's own `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: control-center
      name: 'dsh-control-center'
```

`dsh-hmr` watches that file, so the plugin activates on save; the browser half
is part of the client boot graph and needs one page refresh the first time it
appears. After the first installation the script leaves
`cordis.patch.yml.bak-dsh-control-center` as the final rollback point.

## The three pages

### MCP 管理

An MCP server is a Loader row, not a settings value, so the page writes a
delimited **managed block** into the active profile's own patch layer and lets
`dsh-hmr` reload the composition:

```yaml
# >>> dsh-control-center:mcp — managed, edit it from Settings instead
- insert: [{"id":"cc-mcp-github","name":"@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client","config":{…}}]
# <<< dsh-control-center:mcp
```

Everything outside the two markers is preserved byte for byte, and the payload
is JSON — a strict subset of YAML 1.2 — so no URL, argument or environment value
can change the document's shape. The definitions live in
`$DSH_HOME/control-center/mcp-servers.json`; the block is regenerated from them
on every write, so disabling a server removes its row without losing it.

The row reports its live Loader state, so the list distinguishes *configured*,
*enabled* and *connected*.

### Skill 管理

Skills are ordinary files, so this page is a filesystem editor over the roots
`dsh-skill-filesystem` already scans — it keeps no database:

| Root | Source |
|---|---|
| `$DSH_HOME/skills` | `user-dsh`, provider rank 400 — where installs go |
| `$DSH_AGENTS_HOME/skills` | `user-agents`, rank 500 |
| any `customSkillDirs` | from a live `skill-filesystem` row |

Project roots (`.dsh/skills`, `.agents/skills`) depend on the session's working
directory rather than on this global page and are deliberately left out.

* **New skill** writes `<root>/<name>/SKILL.md` with `name`, `description`,
  `whenToUse` and the body.
* **Raw editor** opens the current file verbatim; saving re-validates the
  frontmatter.
* **Pull from GitHub** downloads one source archive, finds every `SKILL.md` at a
  plausible depth, and installs each bundle. Three URL shapes are accepted, plus
  the `git@github.com:owner/repo.git` spelling:

  ```
  https://github.com/owner/repo
  https://github.com/owner/repo/tree/<branch>
  https://github.com/owner/repo/tree/<branch>/<subpath>
  ```

  No `git` binary is needed: the archive is fetched from `codeload` and unpacked
  by a small built-in tar reader. An existing skill is only replaced when
  **overwrite** is on.

The filesystem provider watches its roots, so a created, edited or deleted skill
reaches the next model step without a restart.

### 全局人设

Each persona is a Markdown document under
`$DSH_HOME/control-center/personas/`, with its name and description in
`personas.json`. Exactly one is active, and the page can clear the seat.

The active document is registered as **one** system-prompt section:

```js
ctx.systemPrompt.section({
  name: 'control-center:persona',
  order: 5,
  text: activeDocument,
  interpolate: false,
})
```

Three properties follow, and all are intended:

* **additive** — the harness identity, the deployment persona, tool guidance and
  the environment suffix are untouched; the section lands immediately after the
  deployment persona prefix at order 0;
* **global** — a preset that shadows `deployment:persona-prefix` for one agent
  does not remove it, so every session is covered;
* **literal** — `interpolate: false` keeps `{{…}}` as written, so a stray brace
  in prose can never fail prompt assembly.

Switching the active document disposes and re-registers the section; the next
assembly carries the new text.

## HTTP API

One POST-only route, `/control-center/api`, with a `method` field:

| Method | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `system.info` | paths and version |
| `mcp.state` / `mcp.save` / `mcp.remove` / `mcp.toggle` | MCP servers |
| `skill.state` / `skill.read` / `skill.save` / `skill.write` / `skill.remove` / `skill.pull` | skills |
| `persona.state` / `persona.read` / `persona.save` / `persona.remove` / `persona.activate` | personas |

Responses are `{ ok: true, value }` or `{ ok: false, error: { code, message } }`.
The route is fenced against cross-origin browser callers: an `Origin` header must
name a loopback host, and a present `Content-Type` must be JSON. A caller with no
`Origin` — the Electron IPC bridge, a shell tool — is already running with the
user's own authority.

## Checks

Both scripts need no dependencies and no harness:

```bash
node scripts/selfcheck.mjs     # host half: frontmatter, tar, the managed block, all three stores over real files
node scripts/clientsmoke.mjs   # browser half: bundle, slot registration, every section rendered with stubbed host replies
```

`skill.pull`'s network path is not exercised by either; verify it against a real
repository from the running harness.

## Layout

```
index.js                 host half: route, API table, persona section, MCP reconciliation
client.js                browser half: the three Settings sections
lib/wire.js              body reader, JSON responder, request fence
lib/paths.js             DSH_HOME / profile locations, atomic read-write
lib/mcp.js               MCP store + the managed patch block
lib/skills.js            skill roots, frontmatter, CRUD, GitHub install
lib/github.js            repository reference parsing + archive download
lib/tar.js               minimal tar reader
lib/personas.js          persona store + the prompt section lifecycle
scripts/install.ps1      one-key install (UTF-8 with BOM — see README.zh.md)
scripts/uninstall.ps1    one-key restore
scripts/selfcheck.mjs    host-half checks
scripts/clientsmoke.mjs  browser-half checks
```

## Publishing to the DSH plugin market

`package.json` is already shaped for it (no `private`, `license`, `repository`
with `directory`, `keywords`, `engines.dsh`, `peerDependencies`,
`dsh.manifestVersion`) and `locale/{en,zh}.json` supplies the store card copy.

The catalog is the curated list [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin):
add ONE file under `data/plugins/`, run `node scripts/generate-readme.mjs`, open
a PR. The step-by-step checklist — plus the entry YAML, a pre-flight validator
and the screenshot template — lives in the repository's `publish/` directory.

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-dd-forge — due-diligence document review (DeepSeek Harness plugin)

English | [中文](./README.zh.md)

**Documents → rule packs → risk report**: feed the deterministic engine a due-diligence folder (registry / equity / financials / contracts / charters / employment contracts) and get a sourced risk report. Built for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/DeepSeek-AI/deepseek-harness); the engine (opcore) itself has zero dsh dependencies and runs standalone.

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ dsh session (model + judgement)                  │
│   skills: dsh-dd-forge-review / -report          │  ← judgement layer (prompt skills)
│   tools:  dd_review / dd_rules                   │  ← deterministic layer (registered tools)
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ opcore engine (engine/, zero dsh deps)           │
│   loader (docs → facts) → rule execution → report │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ packs/ (YAML rule packs — data, not code)        │
│   general-company 12 · contract-basics 8         │
│   trade-contract 8 · trade-bulk 10               │
│   logistics 8 · labour 8 · credit-financials 8   │
│   guarantee 5 · corporate-charter 5              │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-dd-forge
```

Local development: `dsh plugin --profile <name> add /path/to/dsh-dd-forge` — pnpm `link:` installs do not auto-install dependencies, so run `npm install` in this directory first.

## Use

In a dsh session, hand a target folder to the model ("run a due-diligence review on ./target-company"), or call the tools directly:

- **`dd_review`** — run all rule packs over a folder (the `packs` parameter optionally narrows to a pack subset); returns findings and writes the report into the workspace (`reportPath` overrides the report location); the `format` parameter selects `md` / `docx` / `xlsx` (comma-separated, default `md`); the top-up loop parameters are `saveRun` (serialize this run into a re-runnable review.json snapshot) and `baseline` (diff against a previous snapshot — see "Top-up re-run loop"); pass a `targets` array to review several folders in one call (see "Batch review")
- **`dd_rules`** — list packs and every rule with severity, category, and public reference

Skills: `dsh-dd-forge-review` (folder conventions + verification discipline for high findings), `dsh-dd-forge-report` (writing the full DD report on top of engine output).

### Batch review (several folders)

To review several subjects in one session, `dd_review` takes a `targets` array (mutually exclusive with `target`): `targets=["./companyA","./companyB"]`. Each folder gets its own report set (exported per `format` as `<workspace>/dd-review-report-<company>.<ext>`; the folder name when no registry document names the subject; duplicates get `-2`/`-3` suffixes), plus one **summary index** at `<workspace>/dd-review-index.md` (`indexPath` overrides the location): a per-subject conclusion/stats table, a cross-subject high-severity quick view, totals, and relative links to every report — closed by the same disclaimer.

Every folder is validated up front (one inaccessible folder fails the whole call — no half delivery). `reportPath` / `saveRun` / `baseline` are single-run parameters and are rejected with `targets` — to take one folder through the top-up loop, call the tool with `target` for it alone.

### Folder conventions

The engine recognizes documents by filename patterns; anything missing simply leaves the corresponding rules as `missing_data`:

| Document | File | Format |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Registry | `工商信息.json` (or any json matching 工商/registry) | Chinese or English keys; capital in 万元 |
| Equity | `*股权*.csv` or `.xlsx` (filename/sheet matching 股权/股东) | header: 股东,认缴出资(万元),实缴出资(万元),持股比例(%),备注 |
| Financials | `*资产负债*.csv`, `*利润*.csv`, `*现金流量*.csv` (or same-named xlsx sheets) | accounts as rows, years as columns (`科目,2024,2023`), 万元 |
| Contracts | `contracts/*.md` / `.txt` / `.docx` | one contract per file; optional frontmatter: 标题, 签订日期 |
| Charter | any `章程`-matching `.md` / `.txt` / `.docx` | extracts company name, registered capital, shareholder rows, mandatory items, share-transfer clause |
| Employment contract | any `.md` / `.txt` / `.docx` whose filename contains 「劳动合同」 or whose body contains 「劳动合同期限」 | extracts contract term, probation months and its statutory tiered cap, probation/agreed salary, non-compete term and compensation, service period with training cost and penalty, mandatory items and rules-policy wording |

docx (contracts/charters) and xlsx (financials/equity) are parsed **natively** (mammoth/exceljs, lazily loaded — zero cost when absent). Only scans/images need in-session conversion first.

The loader also extracts clause facts from contract bodies for the specialized packs: **deposit amount and ratio** ("定金…N 元"), **advance amount and ratio** (amount form "预付款 N 元" or percent form "预付 N%", feeding the bulk-trade pack), **payment term days** ("N 日内付清/支付" — deadlines that pay a deposit/advance do not count; read by both the trade and logistics packs), **daily penalty rate** ("万分之X/日", auto-annualized), **trade-contract classification** (购销/买卖/采购/销售/供货/大宗商品/贸易 — bulk-trade rules report 不适用 on non-trade contracts), **logistics-contract classification** (货物运输/运输服务/承运/仓储/配送 — logistics rules report 不适用 on non-logistics contracts; a counterparty *named* 「物流」 does not classify a contract), plus 36 clause-presence probes (risk transfer, force majeure, notice, acceptance, exclusivity, third-party inspection, price adjustment/点价, deposit-vs-penalty election, documents of title, auto-renewal, performance bond, settlement & invoicing, foreign-related & dispute institution, cargo damage liability, insured/declared-value carriage, loading duties, subcontracting restrictions, POD & reconciliation, cargo claims, vehicle & driver qualifications, …).

Employment contracts are parsed as their own document type (they never enter the commercial-contract candidate set): **contract term in years** (date form 「劳动合同期限自 X 起至 Y 止」 first, stated years as fallback; open-ended contracts detected separately), **probation months with the statutory tiered cap** (Labour Contract Law art. 19 tiers: <3 months 0 / 3 months-1 year 1 / 1-3 years 2 / ≥3 years & open-ended 6), **probation vs agreed salary** (auto-derived 80%-line ratio), **non-compete term** (months/years normalized) **and compensation clause** (an explicit 「无需支付经济补偿」 waiver does not count as agreed), **service period with training cost and penalty**, plus art.-17 mandatory-item and rules-policy probes.

## Rule packs

Nine packs, 72 rules, each with a public reference (statute or an explicitly labelled convention threshold):

| Pack | Rules | Coverage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `general-company` | 12 | registry status, paid-in ratio, equity cross-checks, balance-sheet identity & solvency, guarantee resolutions |
| `contract-basics` | 8 | essential clauses, digit-vs-uppercase amounts, signing date and signature block |
| `trade-contract` | 8 | deposit cap (Civ. Code art. 586, 20%), payment term (90-day convention), risk transfer, force majeure, daily penalty annualized |
| `trade-bulk` | 10 | bulk-trade special: advance ratio (30% convention), third-party inspection, price adjustment/点价, deposit-plus-penalty election (Civ. Code art. 588), force majeure excluding market swings, documents of title (仓单/提单), auto-renewal exit, performance bond, settlement & invoicing, foreign-related dispute institution |
| `logistics` | 8 | logistics special: cargo damage/loss liability (Civ. Code art. 832), insured/declared-value carriage, freight payment term (60-day convention reading the same fact as TC-002's 90-day line — layered thresholds), loading duties, subcontracting restrictions (cf. art. 923), POD & reconciliation, cargo-claim procedure & deadline, vehicle & driver qualifications |
